name: Salad of Mixed Fruits
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: clear sugar syrup
ingredients.originalText: half a pint of clear sugar syrup

ingredients.name: good brandy
ingredients.originalText: half an ounce of good brandy

instructions.text: Put in the centre of a dish a pineapple properly pared, cored and sliced, yet retaining as near as practicable its original shape
Peel, quarter and remove the seeds from four sweet oranges and arrange them in a border around the pineapple
Select four fine bananas, peel and cut into slices lengthwise and arrange these zigzag-fence fashion around the border of the dish
In the V-shaped spaces around the dish put tiny mounds of grapes of mixed colors
To half a pint of clear sugar syrup add half an ounce of good brandy, pour over the fruit and serve

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put in the centre of a dish a pineapple properly pared, cored and sliced, yet retaining as near as practicable its original shape
2. Peel, quarter and remove the seeds from four sweet oranges and arrange them in a border around the pineapple
3. Select four fine bananas, peel and cut into slices lengthwise and arrange these zigzag-fence fashion around the border of the dish
4. In the V-shaped spaces around the dish put tiny mounds of grapes of mixed colors
5. To half a pint of clear sugar syrup add half an ounce of good brandy, pour over the fruit and serve
